name: Bilhah
overview: Bilhah, introduced as Rachel's handmaid given to her as a servant by Laban, plays a significant role in the family of Jacob. When Rachel was unable to bear children, she gave Bilhah to Jacob to bear children on her behalf, resulting in the birth of Dan and Naphtali. The narrative also records a troubling family incident where Reuben, Jacob's son, lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine. Additionally, the name Bilhah is associated with a location in the land of Simeon, also called Balah or Baalah, indicating both a person and a place connected to this name in Scripture.
